meta.source: read off the RKKA sheet along the railway (N1); C4 accepts a road crossing the railway within 25 m of a crossing point; railway through Prokhorovka = the band with the hatched (black / white) railway symbol, E of the solid main street band

crossings.note: level crossing at the railway booth (Б.) S of 252.2: the 10.0 road from Oktyabrsky continues across the railway as the double-line road S to 245.8 / Sovkhoz Stalinskoe
the double-line road from Oktyabrsky (252.2) meets the railway; the field track to Yamki leaves the far side ~200 m NE (X3): crossing drawn in this stretch, exact point unclear
the dashed field track to Yamki starts at the SE side of the railway, opposite the road along its NW side
road from Prokhorovka (SE side) reaches the railway W of the station opposite the road along the NW side
Prokhorovka station: the main road from the W (Prelestnoye / Oktyabrsky side) crosses the hatched railway band at the station square
Prokhorovka: the E-W main street crosses the hatched railway band (NE of the station)
X-shaped line work at the siding (раз.) N of Belenikhino: road from the MTS / Yasnaya Polyana side crosses to the Belenikhino side
